# konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth_password (Resource)

IdentityPrincipalBasicAuthPassword Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth_password" "my_identityprincipalbasicauthpassword" {
  basic_auth_id = "d41f4f7a-b826-449f-833c-9e1c1604b8d3"
  directory_id  = "862d4d9d-af24-4ca2-ade8-ff5f18badf4d"
  managed_by = {
    key = "value"
  }
  principal_id = "ad5fb41f-04bc-44ce-8d4e-a29b3821b635"
  secret       = "...my_secret..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `basic_auth_id` (String) Unique identifier of the basic auth credential (UUID format)
- `directory_id` (String) ID of the directory
- `principal_id` (String) Unique identifier of the principal (UUID format)

### Optional

- `managed_by` (Map of String) Stores information about what manages this entity, such as the tool or system responsible for its lifecycle (for example, `terraform`).

Keys must be 1–63 characters long and start with an alphanumeric character.
- `secret` (String) The password secret value. This is only returned when the password is first created
and cannot be retrieved again later.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `expires_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity expiration date.
- `id` (String) Contains a unique identifier used for this resource.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth_password.my_konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth_password
  id = jsonencode({
    basic_auth_id = "..."
    directory_id  = "..."
    id            = "..."
    principal_id  = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth_password.my_konnect_identity_principal_basic_auth_password '{"basic_auth_id": "...", "directory_id": "...", "id": "...", "principal_id": "..."}'
```
